name: Lost Gods: Adventures of K&K
detailed_description:
Lost Gods is a classic 2D point-and-click adventure about a curious blue-haired alien and their loyal white dog. Set across a series of mysterious planets, you’ll explore strange ruins, gather clues, and uncover ancient secrets about the Lost Gods.

Switch between characters to solve puzzles and interact with the world in unique ways. The alien uses logic and technology to examine artifacts and solve challenges, while the dog can reach hidden areas, sniff out clues, and sense things beyond human awareness.

Built for fans of traditional adventure games, Lost Gods delivers a calm, story-rich journey filled with visual storytelling, surreal environments, and a slowly unraveling mystery that spans worlds.

Key Features

  • Classic Point-and-Click Gameplay – Inspired by the golden age of adventure games.

  • Play as Two Characters – Switch between the alien and their dog to solve puzzles.

  • Explore Alien Worlds – Visit diverse planets filled with strange cultures, ruins, and lifeforms.

  • Solve Environmental Puzzles – Find hidden paths, decode messages, and gather ancient clues.

  • Discover the Lost Gods – Piece together a cosmic mystery rooted in forgotten myths.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4,096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics supporting 1080p resolution
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any compatible sound card
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: Game runs on most modern PCs. No GPU required beyond basic onboard graphics.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8,192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with 1 GB VRAM (for smoother transitions at 1080p)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any compatible sound card
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: Designed to run smoothly even on laptops or older PCs
